abstract: Three hundred fifty cases of immature teratoma of the ovary and 10 cases of ovarian dermoid cyst containing microscopic foci of immature tissue were analyzed to evaluate the relation between the two tumors. Twenty-six percent of the immature teratomas contained grossly visible dermoid cysts, 10% of them were associated with a dermoid cyst in the contralateral ovary, and 9 (2.6%) were preceded by resection of a dermoid cyst from the same ovary. Microscopic foci of slightly or moderately immature tissue were found in the walls of two of the previously excised cysts. Follow-up information available in nine of the 10 cases of dermoid cyst containing microscopic foci of immature tissue revealed no evidence of recurrence 11 months to 7 years postoperatively. Dermoid cysts that were followed by immature teratomas were characterized by high frequencies of multiplicity and rupture of the cysts. The findings suggest a relation between dermoid cysts and immature teratomas that warrants further investigation.
abstract_ja: 卵巣の未熟奇形腫350例と、微小な未熟組織を含む卵巣類皮嚢腫10例を解析し、両者の関係を評価した。未熟奇形腫の26%には肉眼的に明らかな類皮嚢腫が存在し、そのうち10%では対側卵巣にも類皮嚢腫を伴っていた。また9例（2.6%）は同一卵巣の類皮嚢腫切除後に発生していた。先行して切除された類皮嚢腫のうち2例の壁には、軽度から中等度の未熟組織の微小病巣が認められた。微小な未熟組織を含む類皮嚢腫10例のうち9例でフォローアップ情報が得られ、術後11か月から7年の間に再発は認められなかった。未熟奇形腫に先行した類皮嚢腫は、多発および破裂の頻度が高いことが特徴であった。これらの所見は類皮嚢腫と未熟奇形腫との関連を示唆しており、さらなる検討に値する。
